from PIL import Image

import numpy as np
a = np.array(Image.open('../first_frame.png')).astype(int)
R,G,B = a[...,0],a[...,1],a[...,2]
# classify pixels
orange = (R>110)&(R-G>25)&(G-B>15)
# bright metal: high value, low saturation, bright
mx=a.max(2);mn=a.min(2);sat=mx-mn
metal=(mx>140)&(sat<35)
dark=(mx<70)
# render region full image at 2px per char width
for yy in range(0,144,3):
    row=''
    for xx in range(0,256,2):
        blk_o=orange[yy:yy+3,xx:xx+2].mean()
        blk_m=metal[yy:yy+3,xx:xx+2].mean()
        blk_d=dark[yy:yy+3,xx:xx+2].mean()
        if blk_o>0.35: ch='O'
        elif blk_m>0.4: ch='M'
        elif blk_d>0.5: ch='#'
        else: ch='.'
        row+=ch
    print(f'{yy:3d} '+row)
\""
